scope: Phase A synthetic read-only audit. Native production vs memory-compiled identical coordinator/session with validation-only observers. No result reuse, no HTTP or PG.

diagnosticLimits.eviction: FIFO hash records only; no results retained

aggregation: counts/times sum; keysPeak and existing peak counters max. Inclusive timings are not additive. Full-data hashing cost recorded separately.
limitations: Exact argument-data equality is not AbortSignal/deadline/budget equivalence
Sampler output aliases route endpoints and is mutable
Existing cache hits are not savings from this task
No active optimization; no full latency performance acceptance
